_comment: Shared golden vectors for the weekday chart. Loaded by BOTH suites:
StatsAggregator.weekdayOrder in PotillusKit. The Statistics screen and the
PDF report draw these seven bars on both platforms; until this file the
Kotlin side had no test of its own and the two ports were compared by eye.
A bar divides by how often the weekday OCCURS in [from, to], dry days
included; null means the weekday does not occur at all. Summaries outside
the range are ignored; a day absent from the list counts as 0 g. The
period 2026-08-03..2026-08-16 runs Monday to Sunday twice over. Summaries
are positional [isoDate, grams] pairs, as in chart-bucketing.json.
inProgressDay, when present, names the running day: without alcohol it is not counted, with alcohol it is.

averages.description: two full weeks, Monday first: each bar is the weekday's mean over both occurrences
the same data, Sunday first: the columns rotate, the values do not
a range shorter than a week: absent weekdays are null, a dry one is zero
a summary outside the range is ignored
an inverted range yields seven nulls
a non-canonical date yields seven nulls rather than a crash
the running day without alcohol is undecided: its weekday's divisor excludes it
the running day with alcohol already counts as a day
a running day that is the only occurrence of its weekday leaves the column null
